maya (sec-eng): FYI: we saw mTLS handshakes failing in eu-west yesterday during the cert rotation window. Error traces show KMS HSM denies when signing CSRs from the mtls-rotator service.

ben (infra): I saw that too. We recently tightened keystore ACLs to split write vs sign roles. Seems the mtls-rotator lost kms:Sign for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/mtls-rotator-eu.

li (sre): Short snippet from proxy logs: 
`tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate; sign failed: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/mtls-rotator-eu/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Sign on key/1234abcd (status=403)`

auditbot: ALERT: 18 KMS Sign DENY events for mtls-rotator-eu between 2026-03-22T03:14Z and 2026-03-22T03:28Z. Related change: iam-policy/keystore-split-2026-03-22 applied to group cert-ops.

maya (sec-eng): Was the intent to restrict Sign to a different role? I thought rotator should keep sign perms.

ben (infra): Intent was to move signing to `keystore-signer` role and revoke from generic provisioners. Migration step missed updating the rotator to assume the new role. Ops-side bug.

li (sre): Mitigation options: 1) temporarily re-add kms:Sign to mtls-rotator-eu (fast), 2) change rotator to assume keystore-signer (safer). Which do we pick?

maya (sec-eng): Do 2. But need fast fallback in case the assume-role change takes longer. Ben, can you patch a scoped allow for kms:Sign on the specific key to the rotator as emergency ACL?

ben (infra): Will add scoped allow for key/1234abcd with condition for `aws:PrincipalArn` = mtls-rotator-eu, should be <10m. Adding monitoring for any more denies.

keystore-bot: EMERGENCY ACL applied to iam-policy/keystore-split-2026-03-22: Allow kms:Sign on key/1234abcd for principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/mtls-rotator-eu (applied by ben@redwood).

li (sre): Confirmed: proxy handshakes returned to normal within 3m. mtls-rotator processed backlog. No cert expiries missed.

maya (sec-eng): Postmortem items: 1) migration checklist must include role assumption switch for rotators; 2) add preflight smoke that runs KMS Sign for each region key alias; 3) ensure audit export has deny spikes routed to pager if >5/min.

auditbot: NOTE: KMS DENY spikes currently only log to dashboard. Suggested alert: KMS Sign/Deny > 5 for a principal in 1m -> page oncall.

ben (infra): Filing INFRA-8802 for pager and migration checklist updates.

maya (sec-eng): Thanks. I'll open PR for the runbook changes and the preflight script. Closing thread when PRs link to INFRA-8802. :lock:
